nibValues.NSDev: Keep cards arranged in binder order on a grid.

In freeform corkboard mode, the index cards do not represent the order of the associated documents as they appear in the binder. "Committing" the order will rearrange these documents in the binder to best match the order on the freeform corkboard depending on the ordering options selected below.
